sid-1.fullText:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Everything you need to know

Have questions regarding plans, billing, or enterprise integration? We’re here to help. If you can’t find your answer, reach out to our engineering team.

How does the 14-day free trial operate?

You get immediate, full-tier access to our entire platform, including all real-time observability telemetry, parallel automation pipelines, and team collaboration tooling.

No credit card is required upfront. At the end of your 14-day trial period, you can easily choose a subscription tier that matches your squad's capacity, or your workspace automatically reverts to a non-billing community archive.

Can I switch plans or cancel my subscription at any point?

Yes, absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel directly from your organization settings dashboard at any second.

Upgrades: Take effect immediately with fair prorated billing for the remainder of your cycle.
Cancellations: You retain complete active features until the billing period concludes. No lock-in penalties.
What payment methods and currencies do you accept?

We partner with top-tier tier-1 processors to guarantee seamless international procurement:

Cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover.
Digital Wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Link 1-click checkout.
Enterprise Wire: ACH, SEPA, and BACS transfers supported on annual agreements.
How is our company data protected and maintained?

Security is the foundational layer of our infrastructure. We maintain rigorous compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and complete GDPR & HIPAA readiness.

All cluster databases are encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We run automated continuous pen-testing and offer segregated VPC peering for Enterprise instances. Review our Trust & Compliance Center for live status reports.

What happens if my workspace exceeds monthly usage caps?

We do not cut off your production pipelines abruptly. If your API requests or bandwidth hit 80% and 95% of tier thresholds, workspace admins receive real-time webhook and email alerts.

We provide a generous 5-day grace period with zero punitive throttling so you can easily choose between optimization or upgrading your quota seamlessly without service disruption.

Do you offer migration assistance and dedicated support?

Yes! All Pro and Enterprise subscriptions include access to our complimentary architectural migration scripts and guidance.

Enterprise customers receive a dedicated Solutions Architect, a private shared Slack/Teams connect channel, and an aggressive 15-minute Critical Response SLA backed by financial uptime guarantees.

Still have unanswered questions?

Our technical solutions squad is available 24/7 via live chat.

Chat with Support

sid-76.fullText:
How is our company data protected and maintained?

Security is the foundational layer of our infrastructure. We maintain rigorous compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and complete GDPR & HIPAA readiness.

All cluster databases are encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We run automated continuous pen-testing and offer segregated VPC peering for Enterprise instances. Review our Trust & Compliance Center for live status reports.

sid-92.fullText:
What happens if my workspace exceeds monthly usage caps?

We do not cut off your production pipelines abruptly. If your API requests or bandwidth hit 80% and 95% of tier thresholds, workspace admins receive real-time webhook and email alerts.

We provide a generous 5-day grace period with zero punitive throttling so you can easily choose between optimization or upgrading your quota seamlessly without service disruption.

sid-1.fullText:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Everything you need to know

Have questions regarding plans, billing, or enterprise integration? We’re here to help. If you can’t find your answer, reach out to our engineering team.

How does the 14-day free trial operate?

You get immediate, full-tier access to our entire platform, including all real-time observability telemetry, parallel automation pipelines, and team collaboration tooling.

No credit card is required upfront. At the end of your 14-day trial period, you can easily choose a subscription tier that matches your squad's capacity, or your workspace automatically reverts to a non-billing community archive.

Can I switch plans or cancel my subscription at any point?

Yes, absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel directly from your organization settings dashboard at any second.

Upgrades: Take effect immediately with fair prorated billing for the remainder of your cycle.
Cancellations: You retain complete active features until the billing period concludes. No lock-in penalties.
What payment methods and currencies do you accept?

We partner with top-tier tier-1 processors to guarantee seamless international procurement:

Cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover.
Digital Wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Link 1-click checkout.
Enterprise Wire: ACH, SEPA, and BACS transfers supported on annual agreements.
How is our company data protected and maintained?

Security is the foundational layer of our infrastructure. We maintain rigorous compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and complete GDPR & HIPAA readiness.

All cluster databases are encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We run automated continuous pen-testing and offer segregated VPC peering for Enterprise instances. Review our Trust & Compliance Center for live status reports.

What happens if my workspace exceeds monthly usage caps?

We do not cut off your production pipelines abruptly. If your API requests or bandwidth hit 80% and 95% of tier thresholds, workspace admins receive real-time webhook and email alerts.

We provide a generous 5-day grace period with zero punitive throttling so you can easily choose between optimization or upgrading your quota seamlessly without service disruption.

Do you offer migration assistance and dedicated support?

Yes! All Pro and Enterprise subscriptions include access to our complimentary architectural migration scripts and guidance.

Enterprise customers receive a dedicated Solutions Architect, a private shared Slack/Teams connect channel, and an aggressive 15-minute Critical Response SLA backed by financial uptime guarantees.

Still have unanswered questions?

Our technical solutions squad is available 24/7 via live chat.

Chat with Support

sid-1.fullText:
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Everything you need to know

Have questions regarding plans, billing, or enterprise integration? We’re here to help. If you can’t find your answer, reach out to our engineering team.

How does the 14-day free trial operate?

You get immediate, full-tier access to our entire platform, including all real-time observability telemetry, parallel automation pipelines, and team collaboration tooling.

No credit card is required upfront. At the end of your 14-day trial period, you can easily choose a subscription tier that matches your squad's capacity, or your workspace automatically reverts to a non-billing community archive.

Can I switch plans or cancel my subscription at any point?

Yes, absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel directly from your organization settings dashboard at any second.

Upgrades: Take effect immediately with fair prorated billing for the remainder of your cycle.
Cancellations: You retain complete active features until the billing period concludes. No lock-in penalties.
What payment methods and currencies do you accept?

We partner with top-tier tier-1 processors to guarantee seamless international procurement:

Cards: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover.
Digital Wallets: Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Link 1-click checkout.
Enterprise Wire: ACH, SEPA, and BACS transfers supported on annual agreements.
How is our company data protected and maintained?

Security is the foundational layer of our infrastructure. We maintain rigorous compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and complete GDPR & HIPAA readiness.

All cluster databases are encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. We run automated continuous pen-testing and offer segregated VPC peering for Enterprise instances. Review our Trust & Compliance Center for live status reports.

What happens if my workspace exceeds monthly usage caps?

We do not cut off your production pipelines abruptly. If your API requests or bandwidth hit 80% and 95% of tier thresholds, workspace admins receive real-time webhook and email alerts.

We provide a generous 5-day grace period with zero punitive throttling so you can easily choose between optimization or upgrading your quota seamlessly without service disruption.

Do you offer migration assistance and dedicated support?

Yes! All Pro and Enterprise subscriptions include access to our complimentary architectural migration scripts and guidance.

Enterprise customers receive a dedicated Solutions Architect, a private shared Slack/Teams connect channel, and an aggressive 15-minute Critical Response SLA backed by financial uptime guarantees.

Still have unanswered questions?

Our technical solutions squad is available 24/7 via live chat.

Chat with Support

Security is the foundational layer of our infrastructure. We maintain rigorous compliance certifications including SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and complete GDPR & HIPAA readiness.
